{npc:Jorge}, in the Adventurers' Guild, is a hunter and artist who wants to study the essence of raid monsters. Bring him {item:Silver Raid Token|Silver Raid Tokens}, which drop from raid creatures, and he swaps every 20 tokens for a replica of a rare souvenir from the Thais museum.
Jorge needs raid tokens to study the essence of raid monsters. In return, he carves or replicates a rare item.
No Premium or minimum level needed (50+ recommended for hunting raid creatures).
to get to the Adventurers' Guild from any temple (ask an NPC at the temple for one)
A Thais museum souvenir replica of your choice for every 20 Silver Raid Tokens
Swapping {item:Silver Raid Token|Silver Raid Tokens} with {npc:Jorge}
After agreeing to help Jorge ({key:help}, {key:yes}); ask for the list with {key:souvenir}.
Each replica of a souvenir from the Thais museum costs 20 Silver Raid Tokens.
Keep an eye out for {wiki:Raid|raids}: the creatures that appear in them sometimes drop raid tokens.
You can exchange as many times as you like, as long as you have 20 Silver Raid Tokens per replica.

The {wiki:Adventurers' Guild} is on an island **west** of the Thais lighthouse and has no boat. Go to the temple in any city and use an {item:Adventurer's Stone}: you are teleported to the guild. If you don't have one, ask a temple NPC for another: {key:hi}, {key:adventurer's stone}, {key:yes}. To leave, use the guild's exit portal, which returns you to the temple you came from.

Go to the **Adventurers' Guild** and talk to {npc:Jorge}. Say {key:hi} and then {key:help}. He explains that he wants raid tokens to study the essence of monsters and asks whether you'll help him: say {key:yes}.
If you're curious, the words {key:carving} and {key:replicating} tell the story of his art, but they aren't required.
Whenever there is a {wiki:Raid|raid}, hunt the creatures that appear. They sometimes drop {item:Silver Raid Token|Silver Raid Tokens}. Collect at least **20**.
Raid creatures vary a lot in strength. Assess the raid carefully before entering combat.

With 20 Silver Raid Tokens, go back to {npc:Jorge}, say {key:hi} and {key:souvenir} to hear the list. Then say the keyword of the item you want (see table). Each replica costs **20 Silver Raid Tokens**. To return to the guild, use the {item:Adventurer's Stone} again at a temple; at the end, leave through the exit portal, which returns you to the temple you came from.
Without enough tokens he replies: "I'm sorry, I need at least 20 silver tokens for that."
All cost 20 Silver Raid Tokens. The right-hand column shows the word Jorge highlights for each one; those shown with "-" are part of the reward list but don't appear in the dialogue transcript.
